entities.name: PMID:25080447
observations: Wei et al., Gut (2015): CagA-associated p53 degradation was mediated by host HDM2 and ARF-BP1; p14ARF counteracted signaling. Low p14ARF permitted efficient p53 degradation, while high p14ARF protected p53.

entities.name: p14ARF-dependent p53 degradation
observations: In gastric cell experiments and biopsy analyses, CagA-associated p53 degradation depended on relative p14ARF abundance: low p14ARF permitted degradation; high p14ARF protected p53.

entities.name: CagA
observations: Helicobacter pylori virulence protein associated with p53 degradation mediated by host HDM2 and ARF-BP1 E3 ligases; p14ARF counteracts the signaling.

entities.name: p14ARF
observations: Counteracts CagA-associated p53 degradation; p53 was protected in cells expressing high p14ARF, whereas low p14ARF enabled degradation.
Also known as CDKN2A alternate reading frame product.

entities.name: p53
observations: CagA-associated degradation is mediated by host HDM2 and ARF-BP1; high p14ARF protects p53 and low p14ARF permits efficient degradation.
